integrity: The theorem is proved symbolically. The bundled finite computation is an independent regression check only and is not presented as evidence for an infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The classification is restricted to \(\omega(N)\le2\). It does not settle the plus unitary-totient equation at three or more distinct prime divisors, and the literature search cannot logically exclude every unindexed historical formulation.
title: Exact two-support classification for the plus unitary-totient Lehmer equation
